item.text:
The part appears to have a chamfered lower shank, a hexagonal collar, a short neck, and a tapered head with an axial bore. I’ll use a revolved profile for the round sections and a pad for the hexagon.

The [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd) is available.
